decision: PROPOSED independent cross-check DEM (SDR-001 D-01); not approved
publisher: NASA PDS Geosciences Node; LRO LOLA team (D. E. Smith, GSFC)
use_terms: PDS public archive; cite the PDS data set and the LOLA team. Confirm exact wording before publication.
size_source: HTTP Content-Length; equals 30400 x 30400 x 2 bytes
format: PDS3 detached label + raw 16-bit little-endian (LSB_INTEGER) image

dem.crs: polar stereographic, centre latitude -90, centre longitude 0, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, spherical
dem.coordinate_system: BODY-FIXED ROTATING, MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421
dem.vertical_units: metres; HEIGHT = DN * 0.5 m relative to the reference sphere
dem.pixel_registration: pixel registration per label text; verify centre/corner convention with a known-location test
dem.nodata: No missing-value constant in the label; gridded by interpolation (GMT surface). About 0.004% of points were flagged erroneous and removed before gridding
dem.coverage: 80S to 90S, about 304 km from the pole
dem.gdal_view: GDAL PDS driver reports int16, scale 0.5, offset 1737400, nodata -32768 (GDAL default; the label itself defines no missing constant)

caveats: label calls the source preliminary LOLA data (through mission phase LRO_ES_54)
superseded in track geolocation by the 2023 adjusted product (Barker et al.)
all cells are filled by interpolation; sparse-coverage areas appear smooth
